rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; 11 datasets combined (10 publicly available cross-sectional datasets from different institutions + 1 longitudinal clinical dataset using two identical scanners at Utrecht)
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "Eleven datasets were combined to create the full sample." "We included healthy participants from ten publicly available datasets: the Amsterdam Open MRI Collection (aomic) (id1000, piop1 and piop2) datasets, the Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (camcan) dataset, the Dallas Longitudinal Brain Study (dlbs) dataset, the Information eXtraction from Images (ixi) dataset, the Narratives (narratives) dataset, the Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (oasis3) dataset, the NKI-Rockland (rockland) dataset and the Southwest University adult lifespan (sald) dataset." "Two identical scanners were used"

rci2_using_epd.detail: Cam-CAN, IXI, OASIS (oasis3), and NKI (NKI-Rockland) are EPDs from the confirmed list, all used as part of the 10 publicly available datasets for normative model training.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "the Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (camcan) dataset, ... the Information eXtraction from Images (ixi) dataset (http://braindevelopment.org/ixidataset/), ... the Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (oasis3) dataset, the NKI-Rockland (rockland) dataset"

rci3_epd_name.detail: camcan = Cam-CAN; ixi = IXI; rockland = NKI (NKI-Rockland); oasis3 = OASIS. Other publicly available datasets used (AOMIC id1000/piop1/piop2, DLBS, Narratives, SALD) are not included in the confirmed EPD list.
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "the Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (camcan) dataset, ... the Information eXtraction from Images (ixi) dataset (http://braindevelopment.org/ixidataset/), ... the Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (oasis3) dataset, the NKI-Rockland (rockland) dataset"

rci5_n.detail: Training set consists of healthy controls only: approximately 90% from each of the 10 cross-sectional public datasets and approximately 20% of healthy controls from the longitudinal clinical dataset. Test set = 859 participants.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "The training set included 4310 participants and the test set 859 participants." "only healthy controls were included in the training set"
rci5_n.location: Janssen2024.pdf.md: Materials and Methods / Normative modeling of morphometric similarity

rci6_sex.detail: Training-phase sex breakdown not directly reported. Estimated from per-dataset sex percentages in Fig. 1 table, weighted by approximate training contribution (~90% of each of the 10 public datasets; ~20% of clinical HC N=292, 44.5%F per Table 1A). Stratified split preserved sex distribution within each dataset. female_n and male_n sum to 4310 (paper-stated training N).
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "The per-dataset splits were created using the createDataPartition function from the caret R package, preserving the distribution of age, sex, and scanner (some datasets contained multiple scanners) in both the training and the test split of each dataset."
rci6_sex.location: Janssen2024.pdf.md: Fig. 1 table; Table 1A; Materials and Methods / Normative modeling of morphometric similarity

rci7_age.detail: Training-phase age statistics not directly reported. Weighted mean and pooled SD computed from per-dataset statistics in Fig. 1 table (10 public HC datasets, total N=4710) and Table 1A (clinical HC training: ~58 subjects, mean 30.44, SD 11.02). Pooled SD accounts for both within-dataset and between-dataset variance. Min/max not stated for the training set. Age in years.
rci7_age.supporting_text: "The per-dataset splits were created using the createDataPartition function from the caret R package, preserving the distribution of age, sex, and scanner ... in both the training and the test split of each dataset." Per-dataset age (mean (SD)): aomic_id1000 22.85 (1.71), aomic_piop1 22.18 (1.80), aomic_piop2 21.96 (1.79), camcan 54.53 (18.48), dlbs 54.09 (19.91), ixi 50.82 (16.15), narratives 21.92 (4.66), oasis3 69.44 (8.75), rockland 39.70 (22.96), sald 45.18 (17.44).
rci7_age.location: Janssen2024.pdf.md: Fig. 1 table; Table 1A; Materials and Methods / Normative modeling of morphometric similarity
